labels: But only if she does what I say!

nodes.text: Kimi gets Emily and Ashley's attention and tugs at her ear, signaling them!
Ashley nods and turns to Emily...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What did you just say?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I said, 'You don't get to boss me around! `I'm` a Platypus!'
nodes.text_bbcode: I said, 'You don't get to boss me around! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] a Platypus!'

nodes.text: Emily stands up! The cheerleader guards turn to Nicole, looking for guidance...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't just stand there! Get them!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoops. So much for trying to connect...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Change of plan! Just attack!
Kimi manages to wrest Nicole's dodgeball from her hand!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey!
Kimi turns, throwing it at the nearest guard, pegging her!
Meanwhile, the other guard has a clear shot at Emily and Ashley!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great plan, Kimi! Remind me to give you an award!
The other students get up, providing a temporary shield!
In the chaos, Emily manages to grab the fallen guard's dodgeball!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, ugly!
She throws it in the face of the remaining guard!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Come on! Let's go!
Kimi, Emily, and Ashley bolt for the door!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh no you don't!
Only Kimi and Emily get through...
But Nicole blocks Ashley's exit!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Just go without me!
Kimi starts to turn back, but Emily grabs her!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You already cost us one body. Don't cost us another.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're right...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Let's just get to the library cone before the cheerleaders get it!
But Nicole turns away, ignoring the fight!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes! Blackmail is `totally` wrong, but it `totally` worked!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! Blackmail is [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] wrong, but it [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] worked!

nodes.text: Ashley stands up!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I don't care who you are, Emily! You're the reason we're in prison! That means `you do` what `I say!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care who you are, Emily! You're the reason we're in prison! That means [color=#3b78e2][i]you do[/i][/color] what [color=#3b78e2][i]I say![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As the girls fight they begin to position themselves so that they form a direct line with the cheerleader closest to them...
The cheerleader hurls the ball at Emily's back!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Now!
Emily acrobatically leaps out of the way! The ball sails past...
...Right into Ashley's hands!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Got it!
In one fluid motion Ashley pegs the cheerleader guard with it!
Stunned, the other cheerleader guard snaps out of her trance, her dodgeball cocked back, aiming for Ashley!
But Kimi suddenly bolts for the door!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm gonna escape!
While the guard turns for Kimi, the ball that bounced off the first guard's head lands at Emily's feet...
She picks it up and slams the other cheerleader guard with it!
Kimi runs out of the door, Ashley and Emily right behind her! Nicole half-heartedly calls after them...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... Get back here! Nobody... Else... Is escaping on my watch!
As the three girls put distance between themselves and the prison, they hear Nicole slamming the door shut behind them!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We made it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We don't have time to celebrate yet! Go get the Wirewolves! We might need the backup!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm on it!
Ashley runs off toward one of the Wirewolf cones.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We've still got to save the library cone before the cheerleaders get it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, if Andy hasn't lost already...
She has failed.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So I think it's time more people know about your affinity for nerdy things...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You wouldn't dare!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Watch me.
Kimi turns to the other guard cheerleaders, clearing her throat.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, okay! What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In about two seconds, I'm going to give a signal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All you have to do is... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nothing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just stand there, looking pretty, like someone who doesn't care about heroes in tights with x-ray vision.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Real funny.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks. Are we agreed?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, just don't tell `anyone!` I have a reputation to maintain.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, just don't tell [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone![/i][/color] I have a reputation to maintain.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, wouldn't want to 'ruin' that. People might mistake you for someone interesting.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Pfft. Just give your stupid signal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I like comic books too.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm not surprised.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... Cool, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Did you come up here just to talk to me about comics?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, well...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was thinking maybe since we have common interests, you might turn a blind eye...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Turn a blind eye to what?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Now that we've agreed to at least be civil, we're going to need a plan.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I was hoping you already had one...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because, honestly, I don't see a way the three of us can get past all three of them...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Especially seeing how much Nicole hates us...
Kimi's eyes go wide!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've got a plan.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really? What?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just be ready to start a fight on my signal.
Kimi gets out of her seat.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing? I didn't give you permission to stand!
One of the other cheerleaders aims her dodgeball at Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Relax... I... I just need to talk to Nicole about something...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You can talk to me about 'something' from your seat!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not this thing. This thing you're going to want to hear in private.
Nicole hesitates for a second.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Fine. But any shady moves from you, and you'll get a dodgeball to the face!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I really don't want that.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Good.
Kimi cautiously approaches Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Now what is it?
Kimi lowers her voice so only Nicole can hear.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You might not remember this, but back when my internet video was blowing up, you gave me a ride in your jeep.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where is this going?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm just reminding you that I know you love comic books.
A look flits across Nicole's face. A look of panic that she quickly hides.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I remember. So?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I should totally try to...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Pfft! You heard what Ashley said! Doing what you say is what got us into this mess!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She was talking about you!
Ashley's voice raises!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I was talking about `both of you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was talking about [color=#3b78e2][i]both of you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey! No talking!
Nicole gestures to the two freshman guards near the door...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Keep an eye on Ashley, both of you.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Great. Now escape is gonna be a thousand times harder.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry Ashley...
Kimi resists saying anything more...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But nothing. I'll cooperate. Period.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Good. And you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Doesn't look like I have a choice... Yes, I'll cooperate.
Emily and Keith throw their dodgeballs at each other at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'm the last man standing! Woohoo! { Platypi! Platypi! Platypi! {
Meanwhile, Emily joins Kimi and Ashley on their trek to cheerleader prison.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Glad the cone's safe.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, but something's not right.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If you were the cheerleaders, and you were really trying to take this cone, why would you send Keith and a bunch of no-names?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Hey, that's right. Where's Maria?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `And` Lindsay? `And` Jill? Something's definitely up.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This was just a distraction to keep us occupied...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, well, because of you, we can't do anything about it now...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Best friends know what the other's going to do! I was `trying` to communicate with you, you know, telepathically or whatever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Best friends know what the other's going to do! I was [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to communicate with you, you know, telepathically or whatever!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's impossible!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I could tell you knew what I was thinking! But once again, your selfishness has cost us both!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, how about you taking out two of my teammates?!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: How about both of you shut up?
The girls walk on in silence...
You are now playing as Kimi.
A few minutes later, Kimi, Emily, and Ashley are marched into an empty classroom.
Various Wirewolves and Platypi are sitting slumped at the desks, looking miserable.
Nicole greets the new prisoners with a rueful grin.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Look what Kitty Pride dragged in! Not one, but `two` team leaders.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! Look what Kitty Pride dragged in! Not one, but [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] team leaders.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I cannot `wait` for my free week of summer time! Let's spend the next few hours making plans for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I cannot [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] for my free week of summer time! Let's spend the next few hours making plans for me!

nodes.text: The other prisoners groan.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Shut up! Or I'll put you in the storage closet!
Several muffled voices cry out from behind a door behind Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Voices
nodes.text: Mmmf! Mmmf!
The rest of the prisoners quiet down. Nicole points the girls toward a row of three chairs, and they sit. Ashley whispers to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Dodgeball fights... Prisons... Storage closets....

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We're a long way from pop quizzes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Eyes up front! Nicole's vacation brainstorm. Day one!
As the rest of the prisoners reluctantly brainstorm vacation ideas for Nicole...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Look, Mr. Bernstein said if we get captured, we can escape.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, but he also said if we get hit with a dodgeball trying to escape, we're completely eliminated from the competition.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And that means we `have` to go to the last week of summer school `even if our team wins.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And that means we [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to go to the last week of summer school [color=#3b78e2][i]even if our team wins.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I don't know about you, but I'd rather risk a week of summer school than have to endure any more of this...
Ashley nods at Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... Tanning, shopping, mani, pedi, massage, boys, more shopping?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Great! Let's move on to Day Two!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, yeah, I'm a thousand percent with you on that.
Kimi surveys the room and notices several other cheerleader guards in addition to Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But how are we going to get out of here?
Ashley gestures at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: If we can work together, we can do it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I am not working with her. I don't work with people who expect me to do everything! That's not being a friend, it's being a parasite!
Kimi's harsh words catch Emily's attention.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And `I` don't work with anyone dishonest, distrustful, or straight up slimy!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] don't work with anyone dishonest, distrustful, or straight up slimy!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You guys, shut up! Something's happening!
Nicole interrupts her brainstorm to respond to someone at the door. A cheerleader hands her a message.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha! It's almost over! Andy'll never know what hit him!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I mean... Uh... No one heard that...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh, whatever, the game's almost over.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Psst! The cone Andy's defending is in the library! That must be where all the other cheerleaders are going! Andy's good, but he won't stand a chance against `all` of them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Psst! The cone Andy's defending is in the library! That must be where all the other cheerleaders are going! Andy's good, but he won't stand a chance against [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] of them!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've got to escape!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, `I've` got to escape!
Ashley crosses her arms over her chest.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Well, I'm not helping either one of you escape until you can agree to cooperate. We won't stand a chance if the two of you are bickering with each other!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That's kind of what got us here in the first place...
Kimi glares across at Emily and sighs...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine. I'll cooperate. But...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: But?

options.label: But only if she does what I say!

nodes.text: Emily rolls behind Ashley, pops to her feet, and uses her like a shield!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What the--?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry about this!
Keith throws his dodgeball hard, and it ricochets off of Ashley's head!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Ow! Come on! I'm already out!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Oh, sorry, Ashley...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: A little late for that!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you're protecting our target.
Keith keeps an eye on Emily while Gayle circles around behind her.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Come on, Emily. You can do this the easy way or the hard way...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Either way, you're about to become our captive.
Suddenly a dodgeball slams into Gayle from the side, knocking her over!

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Ha ha! Yes! Surprise attack!
Unfortunately, the move surprises Emily! Ashley manages to slip free, and suddenly Emily's exposed!
Gayle runs up to her...

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Well, this is just too easy...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Get it over with...
Suddenly a dodgeball slams into Gayle from the side, knocking her over!

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Ha ha! Yes! Surprise back!
Emily rolls to her feet, but finds herself face-to-face with Keith!
Emily freezes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh...
Out of time, she ducks!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: They're getting away!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We should stay and protect the cone!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: There `is` no we. And `I` have to go after them! Otherwise, they're just going to come back and surprise us!
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] no we. And [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have to go after them! Otherwise, they're just going to come back and surprise us!

nodes.text: Emily takes off running... But Kimi immediately tackles her!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Saboteur!
Ashley is nearby, on her sad walk to the gym...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Nice tackle! Get her!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What are you doing, Kimi?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You need to stay! You need a better defense!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I need a better best friend!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Uh, girls?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A better best friend? Someone who'll sacrifice `more` of her time for her highness, Emily?!
nodes.text_bbcode: A better best friend? Someone who'll sacrifice [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] of her time for her highness, Emily?!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Girls!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Someone who won't betray me for selfish reasons!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Selfish?!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Oh no! They're here! It's too late!
Emily can see Kimi's eyes flick over her shoulder, to Keith, who is `right behind her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Emily can see Kimi's eyes flick over her shoulder, to Keith, who is [b]right behind her![/b]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We gotcha now!
Time seems to slow to a crawl. Emily looks at Kimi, and Kimi stares at her, as if trying to send her a message with her eyes...
--But Emily's too upset to receive it.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: See ya!
Emily throws herself out of the way, completely opening Kimi as a target!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey!
Kimi tries to get away, but gets tagged by a dodgeball in the back!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Hrk!`

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Surprise!
In a panic, Emily looks around for something, `anything!` She decides to...
nodes.text_bbcode: In a panic, Emily looks around for something, [b]anything![/b] She decides to...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? `I'm` going after Keith! Weren't you listening?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] going after Keith! Weren't you listening?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe I don't think you're capable enough to actually do something right!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Girls! Focus!
As the girls fight, Chris manages to beat the cheerleaders back with a dodgeball barrage!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow... Nice job, Chris...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: No thanks to you two!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Look...
Emily winds up and throws her dodgeball at Deb...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Hyah!`

nodes.speaker: Deb
nodes.text: Hrrf!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yes! Got her!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Wait... That's who `I` said `I'm` targeting!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, really?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is this how you run things on this team?! No wonder you guys are losing so bad!

nodes.text: Girls! Focus!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow... Nice job, Chris...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: No thanks to you two!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Look...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I'll target Gayle...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Duck!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Emily, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ashley, look out!
Keith comes out of his flips and hurls a dodgeball right at Ashley! It slams into her, knocking her over!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Way to go, Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Ashley...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No... It was my fault... For being distracted by you suddenly falling over...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know about that...
Ashley slowly gets up and dusts herself off, trudging toward the gym.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I can't believe I have to go to stupid cheerleader prison now...
Kimi, Emily, and Chris repel the cheerleaders' assault with a volley of dodgeballs!
The cheerleaders scatter, tumbling away from midfield...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Did we just win?
...But suddenly the cheerleaders' direction changes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's never that easy! They're coming back!
Emily holds a position on one side of the cone. Kimi and Chris are quick to form a triangle around it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What's your advice `now,` 'Queen'? More ducking?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that's what I thought. We need to be offensive.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not hard for someone like you--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --I regretted it when I said it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll target Keith, he's closest to me!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: And I'll target Gayle.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That means I'll target...

nodes.text: Duck!

Ashley tries to throw her dodgeball, but she's too slow!
Keith's dodgeball slams into her, knocking her backward!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ha!
The other cheerleaders throw their dodgeballs, but they fly over the heads of the ducked defenders!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Good call, Queen.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `HOOOLLLL--`
But Emily's too late! Keith hurls the ball right at her!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Idiot!
Ashley shoves her out of the way, and the ball collides with her, knocking her over!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What are you doing, Ashley? You just sacrificed yourself for another team!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: It was instinct! I was being nice!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks, Ashley...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: `Don't` mention it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We should--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We've seen this trick before! We've got to wait for the moment when Keith comes out of his tumble! That's when he'll throw his dodgeball!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So when I tell you, duck!

nodes.text: Pfft! I'll never duck at the command of a Platypus!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That's not a sentence I expected to say... Ever.
Ashley cocks her dodgeball back, preparing to throw it at Keith!
Keith's flips gain speed! He's now thirty yards away!
Ashley slowly gets up and dusts herself off, trudging toward the gym.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I can't believe I have to go to stupid cheerleader prison now...
Kimi, Emily, and Chris repel the cheerleaders' assault with a volley of dodgeballs!
The cheerleaders scatter, tumbling away from midfield...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Did we just win?
...But suddenly the cheerleaders' direction changes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's never that easy! They're coming back!
Emily holds a position on one side of the cone. Kimi and Chris are quick to form a triangle around it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What's your advice `now,` 'Queen'? More ducking?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that's what I thought. We need to be offensive.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not hard for someone like you--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --I regretted it when I said it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll target Keith, he's closest to me!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: And I'll target Gayle.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That means I'll target...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Kimi?! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We just took out the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Wait... We?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You mean you and our biggest enemy?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're not working with her now, are you, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: She can't be on our team, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, never trust a Platypus!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know, but--
Dex raises his dodgeball, prepared to throw it at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: If we take her out now, we can take their cone, and with the cheerleaders out, we can win the whole game!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait! Don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Give us one reason why we shouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because... She's my friend!
Emily smiles at Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And friends stick together. What do you say about Team Platypi joining forces with the Wirewolves?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The Platypi Queen would be honored...
In class that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: And so, banded together, the Platypus-Wolves vanquished Kitty Pride and earned themselves a week of summer vacation, summer school free!
The Platypi-Wolves let out a big cheer!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: And I'll be seeing you cheerleaders in class next week! An exciting chapter on feudalism awaits you!
The cheerleaders groan!
Emily gives Kimi the most intense look possible, thinking about what she wants as hard as she can.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Roll the ball to me, Kimi. Roll the ball to me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine. I'll put my stupid ball down.
Kimi puts her ball down and casually kicks it away, toward Emily...
As it rolls to Emily, Kimi distracts Maria!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But you have to promise you'll give us a fair chance to win, Maria!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ha! Why would I give you a chance to win when you just blew the last one you had?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks for giving us the game!
Maria looks down at Emily, ready to deliver the final blow--
--And gasps when she sees Emily holding Kimi's dodgeball!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `Aaah! No!`
Emily throws the ball up and into Maria's face!
`Fwoomp!`

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `Oof!`
She stumbles back into a shelf, and a mountain of books falls on top of her!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It was like we knew what the other was thinking!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know! I totally knew what you wanted me to do!
Just then, the rest of the Wirewolves run into the library!
A week later...
The Wirewolves and the Platypi have gathered for a BBQ on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: All right! Who's up for volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I didn't know you were much of a sports guy, Ryan. It's kind of refresh--

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Guys vs. girls? Dudes go shirts? Chicks go skins?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ah. There it is.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Hey, Erik, what was it like running the Wirewolf prison?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't want to talk about it, Christopher...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Uh, really? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's just say that seeing a man behind bars is like seeing a bird without wings.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: That's... Really deep.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: But wasn't 'prison' just a locked classroom with some cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, I might be overdramatizing. They put purple nail polish on me. Hard times.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'll take your word for it.
Near the grill, Dex and Ashley are talking to Andy.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You're serious? If we guess how you lost your eye, you'll tell us if we're right?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And give us hints if we're wrong?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Guys, you don't even have to go through all that trouble. I'll tell you right now...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I lost it at the beach. Frisbee caught me right in the back of the head! `Pop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I lost it at the beach. Frisbee caught me right in the back of the head! [color=#e23b3b][i]Pop![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I can't believe I fell for that...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So much disappointment...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It got weird between us, didn't it? Like, medieval weird, huh?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Pretty much.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is it weird now? Because I don't want it to be weird.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're my best friend and I love you and we shouldn't let some stupid game get in the way of us!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, I betrayed you, but you were taking me for granted, and it's like we were both guilty, and there was a game, and--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We're cool.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah. What happens in summer school...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Is just never ever ever talked about ever again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, except for the end. That was cool how we beat the cheerleaders.

nodes.text: Yeah that part, and the fact that right now the cheerleaders are probably getting a lecture from Bernstein on feudal farming practices.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Guess who's getting tossed into the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spoiler alert! It isn't us!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Emily

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just surrender already!

nodes.text: You're totally outnumbered!

nodes.text: Jill threw it!
